native_result.query: In what centuries did we see the highest growth phase of the period between 2000 BCE and 1100 BCE?
native_result.HypoA: Between 1500 BCE and 1300 BCE, highest growth of the period between 2000 BCE and 1100 BCE is seen.
native_result.HypoB: Between 2000 and 1100 BCE the highest growth phase occurred in the 15th century BCE (1500-1401 BCE), followed by a second, weaker growth phase in the 14th century BCE (1400-1301 BCE). In the 15th century BCE the 100-year-smoothed vegetation openness score at Belau rose at its fastest rate of the whole window (cumulative change about +0.19 units, versus negative or near-zero change in every other century) while the KDE-based intensity of archaeological finds grew simultaneously at its maximum (cumulative KDE growth about +0.28), and the mean of 12 standardized material-culture indicators (hatchets/swords, daggers, house size, copper/gold, amber, monument count and size, depots, sickles, axes/celts, pottery form and decoration) also rose fastest. The expansion started from the window's openness minimum in the 16th century BCE (level about 0.15, with the largest negative pollen change -0.30 coexisting with positive KDE growth), and after 1300 BCE both openness and KDE growth turned negative (13th-12th centuries BCE), although material-culture indicators kept rising into the 12th century BCE.
native_result.WorkflowB: Loaded time_series_data.csv (3601 annual rows, CE -4100..-500) and pollen_openness_score CSV (decimal=','). Sanity checks: pollen_inter == Belau_PC1_inter (corr 1.0, no sign inversion); raw pollen and raw centennial Z lie exactly on the interpolated curves; pollen_grate_100 empirically ~ annual change of the 100-year smoothed openness (corr 0.996 with pollen_inter_100.diff()), not % of the annual series. Century bins (astronomical): [-2000,-1901]..[-1200,-1100], CE=-1100 assigned to the 12th century. Metrics per century: mean and cumulative pollen_grate_100; provided g_all_mean (mean and cumulative); annual log-growth of kde_all_mean (positive-valued); mean annual delta across 12 standardized *_inter Z series (supporting); pollen_inter_100 level as context. Sensitivity: alternative right-inclusive bins shifted by one year.
